messages:
maria: Heads-up — starting intake for a candidate model: Helios-5B (open checkpoint). Want to align on prioritization, quant plan, and announce timeline. TL;DR: good quality on our internal convo tests, needs 8-bit quant validation and perf tuning.

jason: business ask — which customer use-cases does Helios target? chat assistant + long-form summarization?

maria: primarily a chat assistant with stronger context handling (8k -> tests with 12k windows looked reasonable). Also useful for doc summarization. Customers asking for a smaller latency/cost sweet spot compared to our 13b fleet.

tariq: infra note — recommend initial bring-up on a 48GB A10G node with 1-socket serving to validate memory profile. We'll run cpu vs gpu quant perf fanout.

maria: +1. Proposed fast plan: 1) catalog entry + docs draft, 2) quant experiments (int8, nf4, awq), 3) smoke quality eval, 4) perf/econ benchmarks, 5) announce + staged rollout.

olivia: I can start the catalog entry and a short announce blurb. pinging for required fields — model_id, origin, license, validated_precisions, suggested_routes, known_failure_modes. Any other required?

maria: add recommended_token_limit, perf_estimates (p50/p95 latency @batch1), and quant_notes. Example catalog snippet I used before:

```
model_id: helios-5b-v0
source: huggingface://helios/5b-open
license: apache-2.0
validated_precisions: [fp16, int8-nf4]
recommended_routes: [low-latency-chat, batch-embeddings-fallback]
notes: initial eval shows parity with baseline on socratic-chat and code2readbench.
```

jason: business priority: medium-high. If perf/price beats current 7b, we should ramp. timeline: target internal beta next 3 weeks?

maria: agree. 3-week goal if quant experiments show <1.4x latency vs fp16 and <0.6x cost.

eva: QA checklist items I'll run after the smoke eval: unit prompts (safety prompts, jailbreaks), rouge/bertscore against summarization set, hallucination probes, and regression diff vs our anchor models. Will need seed prompts and gold references.

maria: I'll attach seed prompt set to this thread before EOD. will include conversation traces and expected behaviors.

tariq: quant plan specifics: run 4 variants — baseline fp16, int8-nf4, int8-awq, and 4-bit hybrid. Measure memory, p50/p95 token latency, throughput at batch sizes 1/4/8. Also KV-cache warm/cold tests.

olivia: Announcement draft — short blurb and slack/email cadence. Suggest: internal beta announcement to #beta-users + docs link, followed by public listing after two weeks if no regressions. I'll draft and post for review.

maria: deploy-bot: queue perf job for helios-5b-v0 fp16 smoke on staging.

deploy-bot: Job queued: perf-smoke helios-5b-v0 fp16 on staging (node-type: a10g-48gb). ETA ~2h.

eva: quick question — what's our rollback policy if quality regression detected post-rollout?

jason: default: immediate traffic switch to anchor model with canary/auto-fallback. ops to coordinate for incident runbook.

maria: next actions: olivia start catalog + announce draft; tariq schedule quant experiments (I gave target metrics); eva prepare evaluation harness and seed sets; jason will surface customer ask for prioritization. I'll sync with infra daily until baseline results. Thanks all :rocket:

olivia: noted — will post catalog PR and announce draft by tomorrow morning.

tariq: perf jobs scheduled: full quant sweep tomorrow morning. I'll share results in this thread.

maria: perfect — keeping this thread as single source for the intake. If anything urgent ping me or drop in #eng-oncall.

eva: adding one more: please capture known hallucination cases in the catalog notes so support can triage quickly.

maria: good call. will include "known_failure_modes" section in the catalog snippet.
